name: rto-shield
description: Predict and prevent cash-on-delivery RTO for small Indian sellers.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rto/api && npm run lint -w @rto/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rto/api && npm run typecheck -w @rto/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rto/api && npm run test -w @rto/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rto/api && npm run build -w @rto/web
